method: Local cost probe in Node: the same deterministic fixture is iterated with and without the audio engine in the same process, the median of five repetitions is reported, and the additional per-tick work plus the retained heap of a live engine and the owned buffer bytes are the measured values.
limitations: Local cost probe, not a hardware frame gate: it does not certify the frame budget of the game.
Other processes on the same machine may pollute the timings; the medians of five repetitions reduce but cannot remove that noise.
The heap delta of Node is not the memory of a browser page; the owned buffer bytes are the auditable figure of the audio subsystem.
